en: Ah, yes, well...
Cut the crap already, old man.
You really gonna pull this? Again? Come on, old man, I know it's all a load of crap.
We, the gods of the mountain, shall not stand for this! You have mocked us for the last time!
C'mon, old man... You can't be serious.
We expect little from you, for such base behavior is the nature of man, but we shall no longer tolerate such ignorance.
Prepare to suffer the wrath of the mountain gods and atone for your sins!
Aw, come on! They're real? The old man really pissed 'em off!
Prepare yourself, mortal! The day of judgment is nigh!
I see you are no mere mortal.
Nah, I'm just a regular guy.
We may seem insignificant to you, but walk a mile in our shoes, and you'll see it ain't so easy.
Fool! I see now that there is no point in dealing with your kind.
Go! Live your life like the lowly worm that you are!
Hey, old guy!
Ooh... Ugh...
Yes, I'll be fine.
Yeah? Well, all your screwin' around made a real mountain god come knockin'.
Yes, I heard the whole thing unfold from some deep recess of my mind.
So the gods of the mountain really do exist. I... suppose I overstepped my bounds there.
Tell me about it. You better watch yourself.
Indeed. I will take that warning to heart.
I'm done meddling in such things. Anyway, I'm glad I met you, Saejima. It has been great fun.
My remaining years are few, but I will strive to leave something of worth for the next generation.
Come visit me anytime you'd like, Saejima. I'll be here continuing my communion with the gods.
Couldn't even get a word in with you wrappin' up your farewell speech.
Oh, was there something you wanted to say?
We never finished our talk. You know, the one about why you were doin' all this?
Then there's your magic tricks. How'd you pull that off, anyway?
Oh, um... About that...
Look, if you don't wanna talk about it, fine. But you gotta stop tryin' to scam offerings outta people.
Besides, if you really can do magic like that, you could make a serious livin' off it.
I suppose you have a point there.
Saejima, I must apologize for deceiving you as I did.
But now it is time for me to reveal my true identity to you.
He just disappeared. And what was that about his true identity?
Was that old man really one of them mountain gods?
Nah. No way. That's impossible.
Well, that was a little freaky, but it wasn't all for nothin'. Got some new skills out of it, at least.
You learned <Color:9>Tiger Essence of Blitzing<Color:Default>.
Maybe we'll meet again sometime, old man.
(Uh-oh. Cops. Gotta make myself scarce.)
(Now doesn't look like a good time. I'll give the old man and Sosuke some space for now.)
Oh, come on! A knife? Really!?
Hmm... I need a weapon, too. All right, here we go!
You picked up a <Color:8>Sturdy Iron Pipe<Color:Default>.

Shinada is good at weapon attacks. As his skills
develop, he'll learn abilities that let him gain
the upper hand when fighting with weapons. When
it fits the situation, use weapons in addition
to My Meteor Tackle and punches.
Here are the results! Congratulations to the winner!

<Color:7>Dragon Spirit<Color:Default> Tutorial

In this battle, you can only damage Sosuke
using <Color:7>Dragon Spirit<Color:Default>.

Press <Action:Battle_Extreme_Heat@Combat> in Heat Mode to activate
<Color:7>Dragon Spirit<Color:Default>.

Try attacking Sosuke after pressing <Action:Battle_Extreme_Heat@Combat> to
trigger <Color:7>Dragon Spirit<Color:Default>.

Saejima can unleash a powerful charge attack
by <Color:7>holding down<Color:Default> <Action:Battle_Heavy_Attack@Combat>.

It can be done at the end of combos by <Color:7>holding down<Color:Default>
<Action:Battle_Heavy_Attack@Combat> after moves like <Action:Battle_Normal_Attack@Combat><Action:Battle_Heavy_Attack@Combat> or <Action:Battle_Normal_Attack@Combat><Action:Battle_Normal_Attack@Combat><Action:Battle_Heavy_Attack@Combat>.

Saejima can <Color:7>grab an enemy by the legs<Color:Default>
and swing them around like a weapon.

[Grabbing an Enemy's Legs]
Press <Action:Battle_Drop_Weapon@Combat> near a fallen enemy's legs to grab them,
then use <Action:Battle_Normal_Attack@Combat> or <Action:Battle_Heavy_Attack@Combat> to swing them around.
(Sosuke's not here. Come to think of it, he said if he wasn't around, he's probably grabbing a bite to eat or something.)
(He seemed kind of down. Maybe I'll go see how he is. I'll try the area around Nagasu Boulevard.)

While in Heat Mode, press <Action:Battle_Heavy_Attack@Combat> <Color:7>again after a <Color:Default><Action:Battle_Heavy_Attack@Combat><Color:7> attack to trigger
<Color:7>My Meteor Tackle<Color:Default>.

Press <Action:Battle_Normal_Attack@Combat> to knock the enemy down, <Action:Battle_Drop_Weapon@Combat> to throw
them, or just crush them against a wall.
(Tatsuya said he was trying to think up a new dish for a struggling eatery.)
(So it was a <Color:7>food stall<Color:Default>. Maybe I'll stop by at night when the food stalls come out.)
(Tatsuya said he was tryin' to think up a new dish for a strugglin' eatery.)
(They said it was a <Color:7>new café<Color:Default>. Maybe I'll go look for it when I have time.)
(Tatsuya-san said he was trying to think up a new dish for a struggling eatery.)
(I think he said it was a <Color:7>café that's focused on sweets<Color:Default>. Maybe I'll try looking around.)
(Oh yeah, Tatsuya said he's trying to think up a dish for a struggling eatery.)
(I think he said it was a <Color:7>yakiniku place<Color:Default>, but it's not in <Color:7>Sotenbori<Color:Default>. Maybe I'll take a look if I have a chance.)
(Tatsuya said he's trying to think up a dish for a struggling eatery.)
(It was a <Color:7>new café<Color:Default> or something. I should check it out. I know there's no such thing as a free lunch, but hey, I can still hope!)
(That's just like Sosuke to text his thanks.)
(A technique that's possible only when you're drunk, huh? Hmm, I'll have to try it sometime.)
You learned <Color:9>Komaki Essence of Drunken Thrust (Climax Heat)<Color:Default>.
Stop! Stop already! Have mercy!
You got a <Color:8>Sacred Wood<Color:Default>.
I was... so scared...
I wouldn't doubt it. You know there's no telling what would've happened if you went with them, don't you?
My job being what it is, I won't say working in the sex industry's a bad thing. But it isn't a choice to make lightly.
Ah, but who am I to talk? I'm sure my words ring pretty hollow, don't they...
No. That's not true. I... I'm going to try to help my father like I've always done⑬slow and steady. And definitely not shady.
Yup. I think that's for the best.
Sir, I... Thank you so much!
(Oh, that's her...)
(She was trying to get a job at the Hawaiian pub.)
(Eww. You get what you pay for, room-wise. I hope the girl's at least passable.)
(Woohoo, here she comes!)
Yup, come on in.
Hey, sweetheart, I'm Yuka.
(Oogh!)
(This old skeleton in a dress⑬she's the spitting image of Uno-san!)
It's so cold out today, isn't it? Why don't you come a little closer and let me warm you up? ♪
Uh... Well... I'm sorry to have to say this, but...
But what? Are you trying to say you want a different girl?
Yeah... I'm really sorry⑬it's just that you look so much like a friend of mine. It'd be awkward to take things any further.
Hmph! The absolute <Italic>nerve</Italic> of you! You're hardly a looker yourself!
That might be true, but there's no way I can get down with you. No offense, Uno-san.
How dare you treat me this way! And who is this Uno-san you speak of!? You know what⑬I want nothing to do with you either!
(Yikes. Is this place even legit? Maybe it was too good to be true...)
(Please, let it be a cutie coming through that door!)
Come on in, baby girl! ♪
Hey, big sexy. I'm Rumi, and I'm gonna rock your world.
(Bleurrgh!)
(Another bony old grandma⑬and this time it's Coach Fujita!)
You must be all wound up from waiting. I bet you can't wait for me to work my fingers around those achy muscles.
Well, uh, about that...
Huh? Are you seriously going to ask for a different girl? Again?
Um. Yes.
You better smarten up! Did you come here just to waste our time!?
No, I'm sorry. It's just that your face... reminds me of someone I regard as a parent.
Don't you insult me like that! Even if I were old enough to have a son your age, he wouldn't be as ugly as you!
...I think you might've misunderstood me.
Don't try playing dumb! You must think I'm some kind of fool, don't you? That's it, I'm calling one of the staff!
Listen, you can only ask to change girls once. Quit screwing around and choose one or the other.
Choose between Uno-san or Coach? You gotta be kidding me!
It's Yuka-chan and Rumi-chan! Don't give them weird nicknames!

Look, I'm sorry, but if those are my only options, I'm out.
I'm leaving and I'd like my money back.

You didn't think you could just walk out of here scot-free,
asshole!? Now it's either Yuka-chan or Rumi-chan! Choose!
I <Italic>choose</Italic> neither! I just can't do this!

Enough of your bullshit, man! Your health and well-being
depend on your answer here. Choose one, right now!

(Choose, he says, but between Uno-san or... Coach Fujita?
Either option is kind of horrific.)
Uh, then Uno-san.
Uno-san? Who is that supposed to be? Do you mean Yuka-chan?
Ah, right, Yuka-chan. Her.
Pah! I'm hardly in the mood for this anymore.
(Took the words right out of my mouth.)
You better not cause me any more headaches. So simmer down and enjoy your happy ending, you goddamn jackass!
Uh... Uh-huh.

Well, maybe we can start things over with a little smoochie
woochie. Did you make sure to brush your teeth?
Yes, m'am.
That's good. I love it when a man has a clean, sparkly mouth. Now pucker up, sugar gums. ♪
Uh, then I guess I'll take the coach.
Who the hell is "the coach"? Do you mean Rumi-chan?
Uh, yes, yes, I choose Rumi-chan.
Oh, all right. I'm not even into this degenerate mess of a man, but a job's a job...
(I want this even less than you, hag.)

Okay, we're doing this. Maybe a little kiss would help
sweeten up the mood? Is your mouth clean?
It... It is.
It better be, or else! Anyway... Hope you like tongue, sweetcheeks! ♪
No! No way, no how, no can do! I'm leaving!
I have had it up to <Italic>here</Italic> with you, sir! You want to diss The Cheeky Chestnut one more time, then get your ass outside! I'll teach you who's allowed to be cheeky around here!
Yamane-san!
Sorry to make you wait, Kurashina-kun. There's no one to bother us now. Let's have that one-on-one.
No! Get away from me, man!
Hey! Hold on!
This is where Kurashina is?
Wait... I've seen you! You're the guy who was with Seto-san!
Sorry to butt in, but I need to have a word with Kurashina-kun. Could you maybe leave us alone for a while?

Hey, what's your angle? You think you can just barge on in
here and start making demands like you own the place!?
You're the one who barged in. I don't know which ball club you work for, but you sure play dirty.
Hmph. Don't know what you're talking about.
You're a scout from some team. Using a bribe to tamper with a draft pick? That's not right.
Let's just say I used to work with the Wyverns.
"Used to," huh? This doesn't concern you, then.
Let's just ignore this man and go...
Don't worry about it, Kurashina. He's going to disappear. We'll see to it that you never see him again.
You'll stay out of this if you know what's good for you. Quit harassing Kurashina. Unless you want to end up in the emergency room.
Not really, but I still need to talk to the guy.

What are you, a fucking masochist? I'm telling you to get
lost before we beat your ass black and blue and red, and
whatever other colors ooze out of a broken body.
Sorry. But I'm not gonna back down. And by the way, you're really gross.
You really are stupid, aren't you? Amazing... Well, have it your way. Get him, boys!
Ugh... Someone call the military, tell 'em we found their tank... Seriously, who is this guy?
I'll be asking the questions here. Who are you, and who was with Kurashina just now?
Hell if I know...
Want me to rephrase that? Which baseball club do you work for? You're trying to pry Kurashina away from the Wyverns, right?
Hmph. We didn't pry anyone away. He ditched the Wyverns of his own free will.
Oh, sure. Bet you just waved some cash in his face. I know what your kind do.
